message.content:
I'll provide a comprehensive breakdown of this Businessvance pricing page to help you recreate it exactly as a web page.

## 1. Overall Layout Structure
- **Header section**: Contains logo, brand name, tagline, and description
- **Main content area**: 
  - Price list section (one-time reports & services)
  - Monthly subscription plans section
- **Footer section**: Contains trust badges and contact information

## 2. Text Elements

### Header
- **Main title**: "BUSINESSVANCE" (large, bold, dark blue)
- **Tagline**: "INSIGHT. STRATEGY. SUCCESS." (smaller, uppercase, orange)
- **Description**: "Professional business reports and advisory services to help you make confident, informed decisions." (regular text, dark blue)

### Price List Section
- **Section title**: "PRICE LIST" (bold, dark blue)
- **Subtitle**: "ONE-TIME REPORTS & SERVICES" (orange, uppercase)
- **Table headers**: 
  - "SERVICE" (dark blue, bold)
  - "DESCRIPTION" (dark blue, bold)
  - "PRICE (ZAR)" (dark blue, bold)
- **Service names** (all in dark blue, bold):
  - BUSINESS FEASIBILITY REPORT
  - MARKET RESEARCH REPORT
  - COMPETITOR ANALYSIS
  - STARTUP COST ESTIMATE
  - MARKETING STRATEGY REPORT
  - FINANCIAL FORECAST REPORT
  - RISK ASSESSMENT REPORT
  - BUSINESS PLAN
  - INVESTOR READINESS REPORT
  - BUSINESS HEALTH CHECK
  - CONSULTING & STRATEGY SESSION
  - IMPLEMENTATION SUPPORT
- **Description text**: Regular dark blue text for each service
- **Price text**: Dark blue, bold (e.g., "R299", "R499", etc.)
- **Button text**: "ADD TO CART" (orange background, white text)

### Subscription Plans Section
- **Section title**: "MONTHLY SUBSCRIPTION PLANS" (white, bold)
- **Subtitle**: "CHOOSE THE PLAN THAT GROWS WITH YOU" (orange, uppercase)
- **Plan names**:
  - "STARTER" (white, bold)
  - "For new entrepreneurs" (white, regular)
  - "PROFESSIONAL" (white, bold)
  - "For growing businesses" (white, regular)
  - "BUSINESS PARTNER" (white, bold)
  - "For serious entrepreneurs & teams" (white, regular)
- **Price text**: 
  - "R299" (white, large, bold)
  - "/MONTH" (white, regular)
  - "R599" (white, large, bold)
  - "/MONTH" (white, regular)
  - "R999" (white, large, bold)
  - "/MONTH" (white, regular)
- **Feature list items**: White text with colored bullet points
- **Button text**: 
  - "GET STARTED" (teal background, white text)
  - "UPGRADE NOW" (blue background, white text)
  - "JOIN NOW" (orange background, white text)

### Footer
- **Trust badge text**: 
  - "PROFESSIONAL QUALITY REPORTS"
  - "FAST TURNAROUND"
  - "100% CONFIDENTIAL & SECURE"
  - "ACTIONABLE RECOMMENDATIONS"
- **Contact information**: 
  - "www.studyvance.co.za" (white)
  - "082 377 7490" (white)
  - "info@businessvance.co.za" (white)

## 3. Color Scheme
- **Primary blue**: #003366 (dark blue for headers, table headers)
- **Secondary blue**: #006699 (teal for Starter plan)
- **Tertiary blue**: #004080 (blue for Professional plan)
- **Orange**: #FF9900 (accent color for buttons, subtitles)
- **Light blue**: #E6F2FF (table background)
- **White**: #FFFFFF (text on dark backgrounds)
- **Dark text**: #003366 (main text color)
- **Background**: #FFFFFF (page background)

## 4. Typography
- **Font family**: Sans-serif (likely Arial or similar)
- **Main title**: Large, bold, dark blue
- **Section titles**: Medium, bold, dark blue
- **Subtitles**: Medium, bold, orange
- **Table headers**: Medium, bold, dark blue
- **Service names**: Medium, bold, dark blue
- **Description text**: Regular, dark blue
- **Price text**: Medium, bold, dark blue
- **Button text**: Regular, white
- **Plan names**: Large, bold, white
- **Feature list**: Regular, white
- **Footer text**: Regular, white

## 5. Button Styles
- **Add to Cart buttons**:
  - Background: Orange (#FF9900)
  - Text: White
  - Border: None
  - Border-radius: 4px
  - Padding: 8px 16px
  - Font-size: 14px
  - Font-weight: Regular
- **Plan buttons**:
  - Starter: Teal background (#006699), white text
  - Professional: Blue background (#004080), white text
  - Business Partner: Orange background (#FF9900), white text
  - All have: Border-radius: 4px, padding: 12px 24px, font-size: 16px, font-weight: bold

## 6. Card/Table Styling
- **Price list table**:
  - Border: 1px solid #003366
  - Border-radius: 8px
  - Background: White
  - Alternating row colors: Light blue (#E6F2FF) for even rows
- **Subscription plan cards**:
  - Border-radius: 8px
  - Box-shadow: 0 4px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.1)
  - Margin: 0 10px
- **Starter card**: Teal background (#006699)
- **Professional card**: Blue background (#004080)
- **Business Partner card**: Orange background (#FF9900)

## 7. Icons or Visual Elements
- **Logo**: Shield with business-related icons (graph, briefcase, lightbulb)
- **Stars**: 3 stars above the logo
- **Wreath**: Laurel wreath around the logo
- **Price list icon**: Coin stack icon
- **Service icons**: Various colored icons for each service (clipboard, magnifying glass, people, calculator, megaphone, chart, warning triangle, document, shield, heartbeat, person, wrench)
- **Subscription plans icon**: Crown icon
- **Footer icons**: Shield, clock, lock, star icons

## 8. Spacing and Padding Patterns
- **Header padding**: 20px 0
- **Section padding**: 30px 20px
- **Table padding**: 15px
- **Card padding**: 20px
- **Button padding**: 12px 24px
- **Feature list padding**: 8px 0
- **Footer padding**: 20px 0
- **Gutter spacing**: 20px between columns in subscription section

## 9. Pricing/Subscription Section Layout
- **Three-column layout** for subscription plans
- **Equal width columns** with centered content
- **Plan cards** stacked vertically with:
  - Plan name and description at top
  - Price prominently displayed
  - Feature list in the middle
  - Call-to-action button at bottom
- **Feature list** with colored bullet points (green for Starter, blue for Professional, orange for Business Partner)

## 10. Footer Section
- **Dark blue background** (#003366)
- **Four-column layout** for trust badges
- **Centered contact information** at bottom
- **Icons** preceding each trust badge text
- **Contact details** in a single line with appropriate spacing

## Positioning and Visual Hierarchy
- **Logo** positioned at top-left with stars above
- **Brand name** centered at top
- **Tagline** centered below brand name
- **Description** centered below tagline
- **Price list table** takes full width below description
- **Subscription section** takes full width below price list
- **Footer** spans full width at bottom
- **Visual hierarchy** emphasizes prices and call-to-action buttons through size, color, and positioning

This detailed breakdown should allow you to recreate the exact design of the Businessvance pricing page with precision.
